subject: Fixed-form reference format
notes: kb/Work PB1491/PB1493: a * or / comment line is logically discarded by the §6.5 pass, so its comment-text never reaches the lexer: a comment line between PIC and its character-string (W-P in 2002/pb1493_floating_comment_fixed), unbalanced quotation symbols in comment-text (W-A in 85/pb1491_continued_literal_logical_line), and a comment line inside REPLACE all leave the program unchanged. Auto-DETECTION misreading a file whose sequence area holds letters as free form is the detection extension (DOC-A.1-158), reported as a separate lead.
